title: Pons and Fleischmann cold fusion rumor

tellings.quote: there's this rumor that this is like ponds and fleshmen that we had this sort of breakthrough in cold fusion possibly in the in the 90s or 2000?

plain: Stanley Pons and Martin Fleischmann are two scientists whose names are tied to cold fusion, the idea of getting nuclear energy at room temperature. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, mentions a rumor that someone did have a real cold fusion breakthrough in the 1990s or 2000s, in the spirit of their work. If true, it would mean a huge energy discovery was made and kept quiet.
